description: A confirmed spike on a candle that actually went somewhere: three times the baseline volume, a full-bodied advance, and a taker split sitting exactly on the conviction boundary.
labelling_rationale: The companion to s7-volume-spike-on-a-doji-is-absorption, which fixed the volume and took the body to zero. This one keeps the volume and gives the candle a body, so the two tags §6.2 hangs on that body can be read. **The spike itself.** Volume 300 against §2.11's rolling 20-candle H4 median of 100 is RVOL exactly 3.0, which §6.1 bands as SPIKE because its boundaries are inclusive-low. Quote volume is 300,000, over §6.2's absolute floor of 250,000, so the spike confirms rather than being refused as a micro-cap's small change. **Direction = UP, from the body and nothing else.** §6.2 states the tag as 'direction tag = candle body sign'. The candle opens at 100 and closes at 160, so the body is +60 and the tag is UP. Nothing else in the candle is consulted: not the range, not the wicks, not where it closed within its range. That matters because it is the same sentence that produces NEUTRAL on a doji -- a body of zero has no sign, and §6.2 refuses to invent one -- so absorption_candidate is false here for exactly the reason it is true there. **Conviction = true, at the boundary.** §6.2's conviction tag is |delta_pct| >= 0.25. Binance reports taker *buy* volume, so the signed delta is (2 x buy - volume) / volume. This candle carries 187.5 of taker buy against 300 of volume: (375 - 300) / 300 = 0.25, exactly on the threshold, which is inclusive and so passes. Placing it on the boundary rather than safely past it is deliberate -- a case at 0.6 would pass under any threshold between 0 and 0.6 and would not pin the one §6.2 names. **The other two events are collateral, and derived.** The price shape is deliberately the one already worked out in s7-one-candle-that-saturates-three-components, so the momentum arithmetic is not new: a 60-point advance lifts ATR to (3 x 13 + 60) / 14 = 7.0714, the ten-candle ROC is 60 / (7.0714 x 3.16228) = 2.6831 which saturates §7.1's 2.5 ceiling at 25, close consistency pays nothing on one directional close in ten, and body dominance and participation both saturate at 25 on a window with no counter candles. The score is 75, the differential against the flat window three closes back is 75, and §7.2 records MOMENTUM_ACCELERATING. The three-candle mean range of (3 + 3 + 60) / 3 = 22.00 clears §7.3's 1.4 x ATR = 9.9000 and records RANGE_EXPANSION. Raising the volume does not touch either: §7.1's participation component saturates on the absence of counter candles before any RVOL is compared. §6.3 has nothing to say -- three volumes of 100, 100, 300 do not rise strictly -- and §6.4 is not triggered, because RVOL 3.0 is SPIKE and cross-validation begins at ABNORMAL.
